_readme: Which broker's page each LOADPlus available load goes on. Match on the load's CUSTOMER (Create/Edit Load > customer name), not the Dispatcher_Id field: e.g. KC Structural loads keyed under BRS still belong on Dana's page. Customer match is a case-insensitive 'starts with' on the names below. If a customer isn't listed, use the load's Dispatcher_Id (DM -> dana, PJB -> pam, CS -> cait); if that is BH/BRS/blank, put it on Dana's page and flag it. Add every new customer here when you see one. Loads with a pickup date before today are left off every page (list them for close-out instead). The full origin-by-origin map also lives in SharePoint: Team Callahan > Load Tracking > Daily Broker Sales + Week-End Reports > DAILY CUSTOMER SALES > Broker Ownership Map.csv.
